layout.arrangement: Two-line bold centered title at top (line 2 is a parenthetical subtitle) with a yellow circular slide-number badge '37' at top-right. Below, one large peach rounded-rectangle canvas fills almost the entire slide and contains a single wide left-to-right self-attention flowchart: left column (X blocks → W_k boxes → K blocks) feeding a tan 'Dot Product' box, then a tall yellow 'Scaling by √d' column, then a tall purple 'Soft max' column, then four red ⊗ multiply nodes that combine with V blocks coming from a mirrored right column (X → W_v → V), all summing into a blue Σ box whose result (green arrow) points to a 'Y₂' output block at top-center. A green dashed 'input sentence' strip (X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄, X₂ highlighted pink) runs along the bottom-center and feeds a W_q box → q₂ block → Dot Product box. A small mint dimension-annotation box ([1×d] W = [d×d], 'd: Embedding Length') sits at bottom-right.

layout.hierarchy: The peach diagram canvas dominates (~85% of slide area). Visual weight order: (1) bold black+red two-line title; (2) large saturated stage blocks — tan Dot Product, yellow Scaling, purple Soft max, blue Σ; (3) bright red arrows and red vector labels (K, V, q, Y, X) that steer the eye left-to-right; (4) medium-green W matrix boxes and striped vector blocks; (5) yellow pill callouts (Similarity, Probabilities, Weighted SUM) naming the stages; (6) small mint annotation box bottom-right and small yellow '37' badge.

visual_elements.description: Diagram canvas: very large rounded rectangle, peach fill, no/subtle border, holding every diagram element.

Left input group: light-green rounded rectangle with dashed green border containing 4 stacked rows. Each row, left to right: small multi-cell embedding block (cells colored yellow/pink/white/green) with red label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (top-to-bottom; subscripts very small, possibly ordered X₄–X₁ to match outputs) [?] → red arrow → medium-green rectangle 'W_k^(1)' (black bold) → red arrow → striped yellow/gray block with red label K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ (top-to-bottom). A thin dashed green curve links this group's bottom to the input-sentence strip.

Right input group (mirror of left): 4 rows of embedding blocks labeled X₁–X₄ [?] → green 'W_v^(1)' boxes → striped blocks labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ (top-to-bottom); arrows point LEFTWARD (flow X → W_v → V → multiply nodes).

Dot Product box: tan/brown rectangle with header 'Dot Product' in dark maroon bold (wraps as 'Dot' / 'Product') at top; inside, four small dark-blue filled circles arranged on a diagonal from bottom-left to top-right, connected by thin red arrows — a stylized depiction of the four dot products q₂·K₁…q₂·K₄; red arrows enter from K₁–K₄ (left edge) and from q₂ (bottom edge).
Yellow pill (rounded rectangle) with blue bold text 'Similarity', sitting above the Dot Product box.
Tall yellow rectangle with vertical (rotated 90°) orange-red bold text 'Scaling by √d'; directly above it, a red stacked fraction 'K.q / √d'.
Tall light-purple rectangle with vertical (rotated 90°) dark bold text 'Soft max' (with space).
Yellow pill with blue bold text 'Probabilities' above the Softmax box.

Four red circled-X multiplication nodes (⊗) stacked vertically; each receives a red arrow from the Softmax box (left) and a red arrow from its V block (right), and emits a red arrow upward into the Σ box.
Summation box: light-blue rectangle with one large dark-blue bold 'Σ' centered; yellow pill with blue bold 'Weighted SUM' above it.
Thick green block arrow pointing up-right from just below the Σ box to the Y₂ output block.
Output block: small striped vector block labeled 'Y₂' (red) surrounded by a green dashed border — the final attention output for word X₂.

Input sentence strip: light-green dashed rounded rectangle containing four embedding blocks labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (red labels, left to right); X₂'s cells are filled pink/magenta (highlighted). A thick red block-arrow points up-right at X₂ from below-left. From X₂ a red arrow goes up to a white box with red border containing red 'W_q^(1)', then up to a striped block labeled 'q₂' (red), then into the Dot Product box's bottom edge. Thin dashed connectors run from the strip's ends toward the left and right X groups.

Dimension annotation box: mint-green rounded rectangle containing, left to right: small striped block labeled '1×d' [?] → short arrow → yellow square with black bold 'W' → '=' → striped block labeled 'd×d' [?] (raw glyphs ≈ '1'd' and 'd*1'd'); below, blue text 'd: Embedding Length'.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with dark outline and black bold '37'.
Connector system: numerous thin red arrows carrying the flow left-to-right (X→W_k→K→Dot Product→Scaling→Softmax→⊗), right-to-left (X→W_v→V→⊗), and upward (⊗→Σ, Σ→Y₂, X₂→W_q→q₂).

imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations — the slide is built entirely from vector shapes (colored rectangles, striped vector blocks, pills, circles, block arrows).
A black mouse-pointer cursor (video-capture artifact) floats over the subtitle line at ~x 70%, y 17%.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title and subtitle are bold, ~24–28pt, two centered lines, with red used inline for emphasis; the subtitle keeps an unbalanced-parentheses typo verbatim. Diagram labels are bold ~10–14pt with true subscripts (X₁, K₄, V₃, q₂, Y₂) and a superscript '(1)' on the W matrices. 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (vertical reading). Yellow pill callouts use blue bold text. Mixed casing preserved: 'Weighted SUM' (SUM all-caps), 'Soft max' (with space), 'Dot Product'. No serif or italic text anywhere.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — every diagram element, arrow, and label is present simultaneously; there are no bullets and no partial-build state. A live mouse cursor is visible over the subtitle (video artifact).
recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: 16:9, white background; draw a thin (~2pt) dark-red (#9E1B1B) rectangle outline inset ~0.15in from all edges as a frame.
2. Title, centered, Arial bold ~26pt black: line 1 'Self Attention Mechanism ' + '(Adding Scaling)' in red #FF0000. Line 2 (~24pt bold): '(Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )' — color 'X₂' and 'X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄' red; use real subscripts; keep the unbalanced parentheses exactly.
3. Top-right: yellow #FFFF00 circle (~0.45in, dark outline) with black bold '37'.
4. Canvas: rounded rectangle, fill #FCE3D0, no border, from ~4–96% width and ~20–99% height.
5. Left group (~x 6–27%, y 41–75%): rounded rect, fill #EAF5E4, dashed #00B050 border. Four rows top-to-bottom, each: 4-cell embedding block (cells #FFFF00/#FF99CC/#FFFFFF/#92D050) with red bold label X₁/X₂/X₃/X₄ → red arrow → green #92D050 rectangle 'W_k^(1)' (black bold) → red arrow → striped block (alternating #FFFF00/#BFBFBF cells) with red labels K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ (top-to-bottom).
6. Dot Product box (~x 26–36%, y 36–74%): rectangle fill #D2A870; header 'Dot Product' wrapped on two lines, bold #7F0000, at top. Inside, place four small #0000CC circles on a bottom-left→top-right diagonal joined by thin red arrows; red arrows enter from each K block (left) and from q₂ (bottom).
7. Yellow pill #FFEE58 with blue #0033CC bold 'Similarity' above the box (~y 30–34%).
8. Red bold 'K.q' at the box's top-right (~x 36%, y 37%).
9. Scaling stage: tall #FFFF00 rectangle (~x 38–44%, y 42–76%) with 90°-rotated #FF8000 bold text 'Scaling by √d'; above it a red stacked fraction 'K.q' over '√d'.
10. Softmax stage: tall #CC99FF rectangle (~x 47–51%, y 36–75%) with 90°-rotated #464646 bold text 'Soft max'; yellow pill with blue 'Probabilities' above (~y 30–34%).
11. Right group (~x 66–93%), mirror of step 5: rows X₁–X₄ → green 'W_v^(1)' boxes → striped blocks labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ (top-to-bottom); all arrows point leftward.
12. Four red #FF0000 circled-X (⊗) nodes stacked at ~x 55–57%, y 44–70%; red arrows Softmax→each ⊗ and each V block→its ⊗; red arrows from each ⊗ up into the Σ box.
13. Σ box: #BDD7EE rectangle (~x 54–68%, y 36–41%) with large dark-blue #1F3864 bold 'Σ'; yellow pill with blue bold 'Weighted SUM' above (~x 62–72%, y 30–34%).
14. Output: thick #00B050 block arrow pointing up-right from below Σ to a striped block labeled 'Y₂' (red) wrapped in a green dashed border (~x 57–64%, y 22–27%).
15. Input sentence strip (~x 18–51%, y 87–96%): dashed-green rounded rect, fill #EAF5E4, with four embedding blocks labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; recolor X₂'s cells pink/magenta #FF66CC to highlight; thick red block-arrow pointing up-right at X₂ from below-left. Red arrow from X₂ up to white/red-bordered box 'W_q^(1)' (red text, ~x 29–32%, y 80–86%), then arrow up to striped block 'q₂' (red label), then arrow into the Dot Product box bottom. Add thin dashed connectors from the strip toward the left and right X groups.
16. Bottom-right annotation (~x 76–93%, y 86–99%): mint #D9F2D9 rounded rect containing: small striped block labeled '1×d' [best reading] → arrow → yellow #FFFF00 square with black bold 'W' → '=' → striped block labeled 'd×d' [best reading]; beneath, blue #0070C0 text 'd: Embedding Length'.
17. Final font/style check: everything sans-serif Arial; all diagram text bold; all vector labels (K, V, q, Y, X) red #FF0000; preserve exact spellings 'Soft max' (with space) and 'Weighted SUM' (all-caps SUM).
